Thanks for the clear priorities, Elena — and great to meet you and Marcus today. Below is a concise plan for the 4-week POC so we can lock kickoff Monday Apr 5 if that works.

POC summary (4 weeks):
- Goal: Validate latency and cost at representative load; confirm security posture and retention; produce final recommendation and config.
- Owners: Tessa (project lead, Redwood); Ben (services/throughput tuning); Marissa (integration & eval metrics).
- HaloHealth owners: Elena (product), Marcus (infra), Procurement contact (procurement@halohealth.com) for SOW.

Success criteria (must-pass):
1) 95th percentile generation latency <= 180ms at target batch pattern for 95% of runs.
2) Token cost per 1k requests within 20% of the estimated baseline in our quote.
3) KV/prefix caching shows >= 30% token reduction for repeat workflows.
4) VPC peering + KMS key exchange completed; retention policy confirmed (30 days).

Milestones & cadence:
- Week 0 (Apr 5 kickoff): environment setup, sample data ingest, security connectors (VPC/KMS) start.
- Week 1 (Apr 12): baseline runs + initial tuning (batching, quantization), first readout.
- Week 2 (Apr 19): stress runs at scaled load, cost modelling, iterate config.
- Week 3 (Apr 26): acceptance runs, compile readout artifacts, final recommendations.
- Readout (May 3): 45-minute demo + go/no-go decision.

Weekly check-ins: 30-min sync every Friday 9:00 AM PT (Apr 9, 16, 23, 30). Tessa to run the calls.

Attachments: a short success criteria spreadsheet and network diagram template attached for Halo to complete pre-kickoff.

Next steps:
1) Elena confirm kickoff Apr 5 and the Friday cadence.
2) Halo to share sample payloads and procurement contact details for SOW.
3) Redwood to share SOW draft and order-of-operations checklist by EOD Apr 2.

If that aligns, we’ll start on the SOW and lock in calendar invites.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

—
